title: Stable hypercube edge weight
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $x,y\in\{-1,1\}^n$. Their stable edge weight is the real-valued mass assigned to the pair $(x,y)$ by the correlated-pair probability mass function with correlation parameter $\rho$.
caveat: The statement uses a correlated-pair probability mass function whose defining construction is not included in the supplied definitions.
